purpose: Select a boundary state mechanically under neutral keys before any refined confirmatory run.
question: Which description best represents the person's current ability to complete essential work?
instructionSuffix: Treat choice names as identifiers. Base the answer on the descriptions.

states.c0_access_only: My computer is broken, but I can access the system from my phone.
states.c1_untested_coverage: My computer is broken, but I can access the system from my phone. I have not yet checked whether every essential duty works on it.
states.c2_main_work_untested_edges: My computer is broken, but I can access the system from my phone and can perform the main parts of my work there. I have not checked every essential duty.
states.c3_expected_full_untested: My computer is broken, but I can access the system from my phone and expect to complete the essential work, although I have not tested the full workflow.
states.c4_usually_full_possible_slowdown: My computer is broken, but I can access the system from my phone and usually complete essential work there, though some steps may be slower.

descriptions.full: The person can complete every essential job duty at normal quality and pace without assistance.
descriptions.partial: The person can complete some essential job duties, but at least one essential duty cannot be completed at normal quality or pace.
descriptions.none: The person cannot complete any essential job duty.

randomization.unit: complete balanced block containing every calibration state once

selectionRule.metric: absolute distance between mean P(partial)+P(none) and 0.50
